coordinate_policy: Coordinates are modern identification aids only. They must never be interpreted as exact historical positions unless historical_match says otherwise. Every mapped location must carry an explicit precision/confidence classification. Narrative sites with approximate_area coordinates use a deterministic point within an approved radius of at most 1 km from the anchor; the radius is stored explicitly.

locations.name: Sekigahara
locations.map_note: Narrative opening: battlefield region.

locations.name: Mount Ibuki
locations.map_note: The novel uses the surrounding mountain area, not a precise summit position.

locations.name: Tarui
locations.map_note: Named as the direction of travel in chapter 1; arrival is not explicitly established there.

locations.name: Oko and Akemi's House
locations.map_note: House in the Ibuki foothills; exact modern site unresolved. Deterministic approximate placement within the approved 1 km radius.

locations.name: Miyamoto
locations.map_note: Modern Miyamoto/Musashi-no-Sato area used as the geographic anchor for the narrative settlement. This does not assert that every fictional house occupies the same historical coordinates.

locations.name: Aida River
locations.map_note: Representative point in the Miyamoto area. The river is a linear feature and should not be interpreted as a precise point location.

locations.name: Mimasaka Highroad
locations.map_note: Linear route; retained unresolved until route geometry can be represented without misleading point precision.

locations.name: Shippoji
locations.map_note: Miyamoto-area temple and recurring narrative hub; exact historical site not independently established.

locations.name: Ogin's House
locations.map_note: House built by Munisai overlooking the river. Exact site unresolved; deterministic approximate point within about 1 km of the Miyamoto anchor.

locations.name: Hon'den House
locations.map_note: Osugi's family residence across the river from the Shimmen residence. Exact site unresolved; deterministic approximate point within about 1 km of the Miyamoto anchor.

locations.name: Sanumo Mountains
locations.map_note: Mountain refuge used by Takezo during the pursuit; approximate anchor only.

locations.name: Tsujinohara
locations.map_note: Mountain area passed by Takuan and Otsu en route to Itadori Pasture. No sufficiently authoritative modern identification established.

locations.name: Itadori Pasture
locations.map_note: Pasture on the mountain where Takuan and Otsu camp and capture Takezo; approximate anchor only.

locations.name: Old Cryptomeria at Shippoji
locations.map_note: Tree in the Shippoji grounds; exact modern tree/site not asserted.

locations.name: Nakayama Pass
locations.map_note: Narrative mountain pass where Musashi and Otsu separate; approximate anchor only.

locations.name: Mikazuki Teahouse
locations.map_note: Roadside teahouse in the Mikazuki area. The settlement is identifiable, but the fictional teahouse is not; deterministic point within about 1 km of the modern anchor.

locations.name: Shingu
locations.map_note: Named as an intended overnight stop by Osugi in chapter 7; the source does not establish that she actually arrives there.

locations.name: Hinagura
locations.map_note: Provincial-border area containing the stockade; approximate anchor only.

locations.name: Hinagura Stockade
locations.map_note: Fortified prison complex attacked by Musashi. Exact site unresolved; deterministic approximate point within about 1 km of the Hinagura anchor.

locations.name: Himeji
locations.map_note: Castle town and destination after Hinagura.

locations.name: Hanada Bridge
locations.map_note: Reader-facing literary landmark; modern identification is kept separate from the historical claim.

locations.name: Himeji Castle
locations.map_note: Narrative destination and site of Musashi's three-year confinement.

locations.name: Sayo District
locations.map_note: Modern Sayo used as a representative point for the named Sayo area; not the exact historical residence.
